title: 第5章 上古至强剑魔第6章 沦入孙家变态父子手上的秦灵儿
content_zh:
秦玄脸色一变。
当今太玄大陆，的确曾有好事者，将古往今来诸多强大体质列为一榜单——《太玄神体榜》。
意为归结了太玄大陆古往今来众多强大体质者，共计一百零八种。
要知道，但凡能够登上《太玄神体榜》上的体质，无不是天下间一等一的绝顶体质，就算是排在最末尾的第一百零八名的千焱战体，因为身怀天外陨炎，拥有者也远超寻常武道天才，打破炼体境力量极限不是问题，只要成长起来，将来封王称尊也不出问题。
拥有如此强大体质者，无不是各大势力最顶尖的天之骄子，备受万分重视，身边有强者保护。
虽然秦玄现在炼体境力量就达到了八万斤以上，但想要夺取吞噬这等血脉，依旧不可能。
这时神秘人突然道：“正好，在这里，不就是有一个强大血脉者么？”
秦玄一愣，旋即明悟过来，看向第一层中央坐化而终的剑魔，不由得眼前一亮。
归元剑体，乃是天生为剑而生的强大体质，拥有者先天剑道天赋超绝，一旦修炼剑道起来，进展往往是寻常人十倍以上，极为惊人。
其中，归元剑体，则是位列《太玄神体榜》上第十三的可怕体质。
剑魔之所以能够成为近古曾镇横压了一段岁月的至强，虽然有不怕时间磨难的大毅力、大意志，但也有很大一部分原因是凭借自身是归元剑体的缘故。
拥有归元剑体，让他先天就拥有远超同辈的超绝修炼天赋。
于是，秦玄主动地走了第一层中央。
剑魔虽然坐化枯寂了十年之久，但终究是近古横压一个时代的至强，剑威煌煌无量，莫说是真武境了，就算是天罡境强者也无法走到其身前百丈，就会被那股无形的剑势绞杀成灰。
也就是秦玄，乃是葬天塔主，借助于葬天塔，直接瓦解了无形剑势，来到跟前。
“抱歉了，剑魔前辈，今日晚辈取你血脉一用。”
无论剑魔是因为什么原因，被上一代塔主所镇压，但归根到底，无论黑魔剑还是炎浪剑法，都曾是属于剑魔的，于情于礼，秦玄还是作辑施礼，予以尊敬。
而后以元力凝聚一柄利剑，一剑劈在剑魔裸露的手臂上。
铿锵！
火星迸溅，但剑魔手臂丝毫无损。

秦玄尝试了数次，从其他方面入手，但始终无法破开剑魔的表皮。
他不由得苦笑一声，剑魔哪怕身死，但依旧身体不朽，远不是他所能够破开皮肤。
连皮肤都无法破开，如何取其血脉。
旁边，神秘人似乎乐见其成秦玄吃瘪，而后施施然来到剑魔身前，道：“小子，这剑魔虽然不怎么厉害，但终究是远超你之上，剑体不朽，以你之能想要破开剑魔的肌体太难了。”
剑魔虽然不怎么厉害？
瞧瞧，这说的是人话么？
秦玄苦笑，当即朝神秘人抱拳施礼：“还请前辈帮助，晚辈愿意以刚夺取得来的六十载寿元交换。”
“小子，你想得够天真的，就凭一个真武境武修的六十年寿元就想换来本座的出手。”
神秘人嗤笑一声，道：“等你什么时候拿来了天罡境武修的两百年寿元，再来跟本座提这个要求吧。”
秦玄脸色发黑。
以他现在的实力，就算比起寻常真武境武修更强，但想要夺取天武境武修的寿元，要等到何年何月。
content_en:
Qin Xuan's expression changed.
In today's Taixuan Continent, there were indeed good people who listed many powerful physiques from ancient times to the present - the "Taixuan Divine Physique List".
It means to sum up the many powerful physiques in Taixuan Continent from ancient times to the present, a total of one hundred and eight types.
You must know that any physique that can be listed on the "Tai Xuan Divine Physique List" is one of the best in the world. Even the 108th Qianyan Battle Physique, which is ranked at the bottom, has a body far beyond ordinary martial arts geniuses because of its meteoric flames. Breaking the limit of strength in the body refining realm is not a problem. As long as it grows up, it will not be a problem to be crowned king and honored in the future.
Anyone with such a powerful physique is the most favored son of the top powers. They are highly valued and protected by strong men around them.
Although Qin Xuan's current strength in the body refining realm has reached more than 80,000 kilograms, it is still impossible to seize and devour this kind of blood.
At this time, the mysterious man suddenly said: "Just in time, isn't there a person with a strong bloodline here?"
Qin Xuan was stunned for a moment, then realized what was happening. He looked at the dead sword demon sitting in the center of the first floor, and his eyes lit up.
The Guiyuan Sword Body is a powerful physique born for the sword. The possessor has an innate talent for swordsmanship. Once he starts practicing swordsmanship, his progress is often more than ten times that of ordinary people, which is extremely astonishing.
Among them, the Guiyuan Sword Body is a terrifying physique that ranks thirteenth on the "Tai Xuan Divine Body List".
The reason why the Sword Demon was able to become the most powerful one that had been suppressed for a period of time in recent times is that although he has great perseverance and willpower that is not afraid of the hardships of time, a large part of the reason is because he is the Guiyuan Sword Body.
Possessing the Guiyuan Sword Body gave him an innate talent for cultivation far beyond his peers.
So, Qin Xuan took the initiative to walk to the center of the first floor.
Although the sword demon has been lying dormant for ten years, he is still the most powerful person in recent times who has dominated an era. His sword power is immeasurable. Not to mention the true martial arts realm, even a strong Tiangang realm expert cannot walk a hundred feet in front of him without being strangled to ashes by the invisible force of the sword.
That is, Qin Xuan, the master of the Heaven Burial Tower, directly disintegrated the invisible sword force with the help of the Heaven Burial Tower and came to the front.
"Sorry, Senior Sword Demon, I will use your blood today."
Regardless of the reasons why the sword demon was suppressed by the previous generation of tower masters, in the final analysis, both the Black Demon Sword and the Yanlang Sword Technique once belonged to the sword demon. In terms of love and etiquette, Qin Xuan still treated them with respect.
Then he used his Yuan Power to condense a sharp sword, and struck the sword demon's exposed arm with one strike.
Sonorous!
Sparks flew out, but the sword demon's arm was not damaged at all.
Qin Xuan tried several times and started from other aspects, but he was still unable to break through the sword demon's skin.
He couldn't help but smile bitterly. Even if the sword demon died, his body would still be immortal. It was far beyond his ability to break through the skin.
Even the skin cannot be broken, how to get its blood.
Next to him, the mysterious man seemed to be happy to see Qin Xuan defeated. Then Shi Shiran came to the sword demon and said: "Boy, although this sword demon is not very powerful, it is far superior to you after all. The sword body is immortal. It is too difficult for you to break through the sword demon's body."
Although the sword demon is not very powerful?
Look, is this human language?
Qin Xuan smiled bitterly, and immediately saluted the mysterious man with cupped fists: "Senior, please help me. I am willing to exchange the sixty years of life you just won."
"Boy, you are so naive. You want to get me to take action with just the sixty years of life of a true martial artist."
The mysterious man sneered and said: "Whenever you bring the two hundred years of life of a Tiangang realm martial artist, come and make this request to me."
Qin Xuan's face turned dark.
With his current strength, even if he is stronger than ordinary Zhenwu Realm martial arts cultivators, it will take many years and months to seize the longevity of Tianwu Realm martial arts cultivators.
